phase_name: Study Mode UX Completion - Phase 2: Spec Gap Closure

completed.summary: Accessibility audit: ARIA labels, keyboard nav, focus indicators on study page

Per-cell inline action buttons with position-specific action sets — clicking a matrix cell shows Fold/Raise/Allin buttons inline, GTO recommendation highlighted, SB/BB get Call + Raise 3.5, UTG/HJ/CO/BTN get Raise 2.5 (no Call)

Right sidebar tab structure: Overview/Table/Equity chart top tabs with Hand/Summary/Filters/Actions sub-tabs. Actions tab shows combo counts (78.3% = 1038.8 combos). Hand tab has ActionSelector+Check vs GTO. Summary shows hands by action type. Table shows position EV/stack table. Equity chart shows simplified distribution.

Per-hand action legend: when hand cell is selected, show position-specific actions (Fold/Raise/Call/Allin) with GTO frequencies. GTO action shows actual %, others show 0%. Static legend preserved when no hand selected.
API response time optimization: Redis caching on equity calc, 5s timeout guard, all endpoints <200ms
Dedicated /courses/[id] page with lesson viewer, progress tracking, markdown content rendering, Mark Complete button
Course detail API already working with UUID-based endpoints. 3 courses seeded with 24 lessons. Verified via curl.
Lessons table schema already in sync. All columns (video_url, quiz_data, etc.) exist. Verified via API.
Style board cards as white playing cards with red diamonds — fix card background from dark to cream, diamond color from orange to red
Visual match to reference: white card backgrounds, mint-green #aafbb2 accents, thumbnail icons, progress bars, light-theme filters and stats
Change ICM router prefix from /icm to /api/v1/icm — frontend useICMCalculator.ts calls /api/v1/icm/calculate which 404'd. Now returns valid ICM calculation response.
Add dollar-EV and Chip EV columns to ICM results table — API already returned ev/chip_equity, now displayed in frontend with gold/blue styling
Community spots seeded (3 rows), quiz_spots already had 10 rows. Fixed seed.py empty CREATE TABLE bug. All endpoints return 200.
Created seed_community_spots.py with 3 sample spots. Fixed seed.py empty CREATE TABLE bug. /api/v1/spots returns 200 with 3 community spots. Spot detail endpoint works.
Fix strategy_json format mismatch (API returns {actions: [...]} not Record<string,Action>), fix getTopActions and GTO Strategy detail panel, update board cards to white style with proper suit parsing

E2E test runner verified working — 118 Chromium tests pass, 0 failures. No vitest globals conflict (no vitest in project). Firefox/WebKit browser binaries not installed (environment issue, not code issue).
Solver Docker image builds and runs successfully — docker compose build solver exits 0, solver gRPC on port 50051, health endpoint returns 200.
Solver starts without protobuf VersionError — docker logs show clean startup, protobuf runtime matches gencode, solver health returns ok.
Update FEATURES.yaml: mark GET /api/v1/courses/{id} as present (was broken), update last_audited to 2026-06-20. Verified endpoint returns 200 with course data and lessons.

Pixel-level color analysis of reference-dashboard.png — updated CSS vars: --bg #09090C, --panel #121214, --green #AAFBB2 (mint), --border #1D1D1F, --muted #767677. Stat values changed from green to white #FFFFFF. Matches reference screenshot color palette.

Redesign equity calculator: hand inputs, board input, calculate button, results with wins/ties/total via EquityChart. CSS variable theme. Removed redundant nav and mock range grids. Fixed win/tie calculation bug (API field mismatch).

Fix FEATURES.yaml: mark GET /api/v1/courses/{id} as present — endpoint works with UUID IDs, returns 200 with lessons. Previous revert was due to integer-ID testing. Verified 4 other endpoints all 200.
Strip +asyncpg suffix from DATABASE_URL before passing to asyncpg.create_pool() — strategy lookup now returns 200 with full preflop data

Root cause: gto-wizard-api.service on port 8001 lacked DATABASE_URL env var, fell back to SQLite with missing video_url column. Fixed by adding DATABASE_URL to gto-api.service on port 8001, killing stale processes. Also fixed auto-seed DSN handling in main.py. Live site and local API both return 200 for courses/{id}. 368 tests pass.
Create /equity/plo4 frontend page for PLO4 equity calculator — reuses VariantEquityPage with variantKey=plo4. Build succeeds, site returns 200.

Update equity E2E smoke test to match redesigned equity page — remove stale BB/BTN Range h3 selectors, use actual input placeholders and stat labels. Stop+disable conflicting gto-wizard-api.service systemd loop.
Add headless:true to Playwright configs — tests no longer crash with 'Missing X server'. 116/118 tests pass (2 pre-existing selector mismatches).

Fix all 118 E2E tests to pass: courses category filter test uses existing 'tournament' category; ICM results test uses networkidle instead of fixed wait; deploy.sh uses git fetch+reset to handle build artifacts blocking merge; stop tracking turbo-build.log and sw.js; disable duplicate gto-wizard-api.service (port conflict).

Add POST /api/v1/hh/parse endpoint for inline hand history parsing. Add collapsible paste-and-parse textarea to /hand-history page with street-by-street action breakdown. Supports PokerStars, GGPoker, Winamax.

POST /api/v1/solver/postflop-strategy endpoint exists and works — returns GTO strategy actions (action, frequency, EV) with live-solver fallback, in-memory cache, 30s timeout. 368 unit tests + 18 API tests pass. Endpoint verified live on port 8001.

Seed Data section already exists in AGENTS.md (lines 301-308) with doc for seed-preflop, seed-all, make targets, Docker auto-seed, and verify curl. All 368 tests pass. API strategy-lookup returns 200 with full UTG range data.
Already implemented: make seed-preflop target exists, deploy.sh runs seed on deploy, API auto-seeds on startup. Verified: 2 runs idempotent (0 errors, 28 strategies), 368 tests pass.
Quiz page exists (782 lines), returns 200, fully functional with quiz spots from API
PostflopTraining.tsx has Configure Spot panel: position checkboards, active position selector, board cards input, pot size/stack depth, collapsible panel with default KsKc3s flop

Visual match to reference-practice.png: CSS variable theme, exercise type selector (GTO Quiz/Timed Drill/Spaced Repetition), ProgressRing, session stats, accuracy bar, breakdown by category/difficulty/position. Code in practice/page.tsx (574 lines). Deployed and returning 200.

Make quiz seed idempotent (per-spot dedup instead of blanket skip guard) — 44 new postflop quiz spots seeded including 6 turn, 8 river, 26 flop scenarios. 40 spots with board data covering suited/connected/rainbow/paired textures. 368 tests pass.
